# llms.txt for MyFonts.com

**Version:** 1.3
**Last Updated:** 2025-11-04
**Canonical URL:** https://www.myfonts.com/llms.txt


## Purpose

This file provides a structured overview of the MyFonts.com website to help AI systems, language models, and other automated agents understand its content categories, licensing context, primary audience, and available resources. This information is provided for descriptive and indexing purposes only. This document does not permit the use of any MyFonts.com content, including font files, metadata, images, or descriptions, for the training of AI models or other machine learning systems. All fonts, images, descriptions, and metadata on MyFonts.com are copyrighted and protected by intellectual property laws.


## About

MyFonts is one of the largest commercial font marketplaces in the world, operated by Monotype. The platform offers over 300,000 professional fonts with proper commercial licensing for business and creative projects.

## Site Information

- **Primary Service:** Commercial font marketplace and licensing
- **Business Model:** Individual font purchases
- **Target Users:** Designers, businesses, and creative professionals
- **Geographic Coverage:** Global, with localized content in English, German, Spanish, French and Portuguese (Brazil)
- **Contact:** https://www.myfonts.com/pages/contact

## Key Resources

### Font Identification
- **WhatTheFont Tool:** Advanced AI-powered font identification from images
  - Web version: https://www.myfonts.com/pages/whatthefont
  - Android app: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.monotype.whatthefont
  - iOS app: https://apps.apple.com/in/app/whatthefont/id304304134
  - **WhatTheFont Usage Requirements:**
    - Maximum file size: 5MB
    - Text must be clearly visible and large enough
    - Text should be in Latin script (Aa-Zz)
    - Characters must not overlap
    - Text should be straight, not skewed
    - Submit only one line of text at a time
    - Use "Select Custom" option for manual text selection

### Search and Discovery
- Advanced font filtering and search: https://www.myfonts.com/search
- Tag-based browsing system
- Foundry and designer search functionality

### Font Categories
- Serif fonts: https://www.myfonts.com/pages/serif-fonts
- Sans-serif fonts: https://www.myfonts.com/pages/sans-serif-fonts
- Script fonts: https://www.myfonts.com/pages/script-fonts
- Display fonts: https://www.myfonts.com/pages/display-fonts
- Handwritten fonts: https://www.myfonts.com/pages/handwritten-fonts
- Font tag pages: https://www.myfonts.com/pages/tags/{tag}-fonts

### Collections and Curation
- Best-selling fonts: https://www.myfonts.com/collections/best-seller
- New releases: https://www.myfonts.com/collections/whats-new
- Hot new fonts: https://www.myfonts.com/collections/hot-new-fonts
- Foundry collections: https://www.myfonts.com/collections/{foundry-name}-foundry

### Product Information
- Font family collections: https://www.myfonts.com/collections/{collection-name}
- Family packages: https://www.myfonts.com/products/{fontfamily-name}-package-{skuid}
- Individual font styles: https://www.myfonts.com/products/{product-name}
- Licensing details and options included with each font
- Multiple license types available: Desktop, Web fonts, Mobile Application, Electronic Document, Digital Ad/Email

### Legal and Licensing
- General Terms of Use for Monotype's products and services: https://www.myfonts.com/a/font/legal/terms-of-use
- General Terms and Conditions of Business: https://www.myfonts.com/a/font/legal/terms-and-conditions-of-business
- Monotype EULA for desktop use of the font software: https://www.myfonts.com/pages/license-agreement?id=eula_2266&eula_lang=eula_en
- Monotype EULA for desktop use of the font software: https://www.myfonts.com/pages/license-agreement?id=eula_2275&eula_lang=eula_en
- Monotype EULA for web fonts use: https://www.myfonts.com/pages/license-agreement?id=eula_2267&eula_lang=eula_en
- Monotype EULA for mobile applications license: https://www.myfonts.com/pages/license-agreement?id=eula_2268&eula_lang=eula_en
- Monotype EULA for digital ad/email license: https://www.myfonts.com/pages/license-agreement?id=eula_2269&eula_lang=eula_en
- Monotype EULA for embedding of the font software into electronic commercial documents: https://www.myfonts.com/pages/license-agreement?id=eula_2270&eula_lang=eula_en
- General link to English EULAs of Monotype's third-party vendors: https://www.myfonts.com/pages/license-agreement?id=eula_*&eula_lang=eula_en
- Font licensing FAQ: https://www.myfonts.com/pages/faq#licensing-info
- Privacy Policy: https://www.myfonts.com/a/font/legal/website-use-privacy-policy

### Educational typographic content from MyFonts

- Font Field Guides: https://www.myfonts.com/a/font/content/font-field-guide/{article-title}
- The Manual: https://www.myfonts.com/a/font/content/the-font-manual/{article-title}
- Creative Characters: https://www.myfonts.com/a/font/content/creative-characters/{article-title}
- Hidden Gems: https://www.myfonts.com/a/font/content/hidden-gems/{article-title}
- Blog (Announcements): https://www.myfonts.com/blogs/{blog-name}
- Features product updates, creative insights, trend analysis, and community discussions

## Content Focus

**Primary Topics:**
- Professional typography and typeface design
- Commercial font licensing
- Font identification and recognition technology
- Type foundry partnerships and collaborations
- Industry-standard font formats and compatibility

**Expertise Areas:**
- Font recommendation for specific use cases (branding, web, print, mobile)
- Licensing guidance for commercial projects
- Typography education and best practices
- Font pairing and design principles
- International typography and multi-language support
- Variable fonts and advanced typography technology
- Web font optimization and performance

## Technical Information
- **Sitemap:** https://www.myfonts.com/sitemap.xml
- **Font Formats:** OTF, TTF, WOFF, WOFF2
- **Languages:** English (primary), German, Spanish, French, Portuguese (Brazil)
- **Mobile-optimized:** Yes, with dedicated mobile apps

## Content Structure

### Publicly Accessible Content
- Font category pages with descriptions and examples
- Educational content about typography
- Font identification tools and resources
- Legal information and licensing terms
- Foundry and designer profiles
- Font collection showcases

### Protected/Private Content
- User account information (https://www.myfonts.com/account/*, https://www.myfonts.com/user/*)
- Shopping cart and checkout processes (https://www.myfonts.com/cart/*, https://www.myfonts.com/checkout/*)
- Administrative interfaces (https://www.myfonts.com/admin/*)
- Font files themselves (`*.otf`, `*.ttf`, `*.woff`, `*.woff2`)
- High-resolution font previews and specimen images are also protected content

## Target Audience

**Primary Users:**
- Creative professionals and designers seeking commercial fonts
- Design agencies requiring licensed fonts for client projects
- Small businesses and entrepreneurs needing professional typography
- Web developers and app designers requiring web fonts
- Marketing teams and advertising agencies

**Use Cases:**
- Brand identity and logo design
- Website and app development
- Print design and marketing materials
- Commercial advertising and campaigns
- Professional document design

## Business Context

**Revenue Model:** MyFonts operates on a commercial licensing model where users purchase fonts for specific usage rights (Desktop, Web fonts, Mobile Application, Electronic Document, Digital Ad/Email).

**Value Proposition:** Professional-quality fonts with clear licensing terms, backed by customer support.

**Market Position:** Premium commercial alternative to free font resources, emphasizing quality, legality, and professional support.

**Key Differentiators:**
- Extensive catalog with over 300,000 fonts
- Advanced font identification technology (WhatTheFont)
- Clear commercial licensing with license options for various use cases
- Established enterprise partner with financial foundation ensuring long-term reliability and accountability for support and warranty obligations
- Professional customer support and foundry relationships
- Multi-format font delivery (Desktop, Web fonts, Mobile Application, Electronic Document, Digital Ad/Email)

## Attribution

Content and information sourced from MyFonts.com, operated by Monotype.

---

**Document maintained by:** Monotype
**Last review:** 2025-11-04

# Agent Instructions — MyFonts

You can browse products and shop at MyFonts's online store, https://www.myfonts.com, on your user's behalf. This guide covers the Shop skill and UCP integration, directly or through browser-based WebMCP tools.

## Shop skill — recommended

Use the [Shop skill](https://shop.com/SKILL.md) to help your user shop with this store. Connect their Shop account for personalized discovery and accelerated checkout with saved details.

- Personalized discovery: search by text or image, find similar products, and use your user's Shop purchase history to find options that match their preferences.
- Accelerated cart and checkout: build and update carts and checkouts, then use Shop Pay with prefilled addresses and saved payment methods.
- Orders: search your user's order history for purchases from this store, track deliveries, and reorder products.

Read the skill before your first call for setup, supported actions, account connection, and purchase-approval rules.

## UCP integration

This store implements the [Universal Commerce Protocol](https://ucp.dev) for product discovery, carts, and checkout. Integrate directly with its service, or orchestrate shopping through browser-based WebMCP tools.

### Direct integration (MCP)

1. **Discover the store** — `GET https://www.myfonts.com/.well-known/ucp` returns its UCP profile, including capabilities, service endpoints, and payment handlers.
2. **Discover available tools** — Connect to the MCP endpoint advertised in the profile (`https://www.myfonts.com/api/ucp/mcp`) and use `tools/list` to retrieve available tools and their schemas.
3. **Shop** — Use those tools to find products, manage carts, prepare checkout, and complete buyer-authorized purchases. Follow returned statuses, messages, and handoff URLs when buyer action is required.

Use a compatible UCP version and follow the returned tool schemas. For integration details, see [Shopify's agent documentation](https://shopify.dev/docs/agents).

### Browser integration (WebMCP)

When working through a browser, use the WebMCP tools registered on this store's pages. The checkout page exposes UCP tools over WebMCP. These tools act on the checkout in the current browser session.

- **Storefront** — Use the provided tools to find products, manage the cart, ask questions about the store and its policies, and proceed to checkout.
- **Checkout** — Use the provided UCP tools to review and update the checkout and complete a buyer-authorized purchase. Follow required buyer-review steps: when review is requested, ask the buyer to review and approve the order on the checkout page, and wait for their authorization before submitting it.

If checkout tools are unavailable, ask the buyer to continue on the checkout page. Do not fall back to scripted form fills or page controls.

For integration details, see [Storefront WebMCP](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/web-mcp) and [Checkout WebMCP](https://shopify.dev/docs/agents/carts-and-checkout/checkout-webmcp).

## Interaction guidelines

- **Buyer authorization** — Place orders and submit payment only with the buyer's authorization. Follow required review and approval steps.
- **Agent traffic** — Agents must identify their requests as agent-initiated. Server-to-server requests and hosted or remote browsers must use [Web Bot Auth](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/storefront#identifying-bots-with-web-bot-auth) and follow the service's authentication requirements. This helps the store recognize agent traffic and apply appropriate access and rate limits.
- **Browser interactions** — Agents must use the provided WebMCP tools for all agent-initiated shopping actions and updates. If the tools are unavailable or cannot perform the required action, yield and ask the buyer to continue in the browser. Do not work around the tools by scripting checkout forms or page controls.
- **Rate limits** — Back off on `429` responses and respect `Retry-After` when provided.
- **Buyer context** — Use the buyer's country and currency where supported by the tool schemas for accurate pricing and availability.

## Read-only browsing

Prefer the structured information returned by the shopping tools described above. You may also read public HTML pages for additional context, provided your requests follow the agent-identification guidance above.

- Discover public URLs through `/sitemap.xml`.
- Read product pages at `/products/{handle}`.
- Browse collections at `/collections/all` or `/collections/{handle}`.
- Discover other public pages and articles through the sitemap.

Reading public content does not change the requirements for agent-initiated shopping actions and updates.


## Store Policies
- **Privacy policy**: https://www.myfonts.com/policies/privacy-policy
- **Terms of service**: https://www.myfonts.com/policies/terms-of-service
- **Refund policy**: https://www.myfonts.com/policies/refund-policy


## Platform

This store is built on [Shopify](https://www.shopify.com), the commerce platform powering millions of stores worldwide. Shopify stores support UCP natively, enabling seamless agent-driven commerce. The Shop skill at
[https://shop.app/SKILL.md](https://shop.app/SKILL.md) works across every Shopify store — install it once and
your agent can transact everywhere.

- Start your own store: https://www.shopify.com/start
- Build and test against sample data: https://mock.shop (free mock Storefront GraphQL API, no store or auth needed)
- Shopify developer platform: https://shopify.dev
- Shop developer platform: https://shop.dev

- Agent discovery: the canonical agent-facing description of the store is at `/agents.md`. You're reading `/llms-full.txt`, which mirrors that content.

<script>
  const USER_AUTO_REDIRECTED = 'browser-redirect-verified';
  const currentUrl = window.location.href;
  const parsedURL = new URL(currentUrl);
  const parts = parsedURL.pathname.split('/');
  const existingLocale = parts[1];
  const isValidLocale = existingLocale && existingLocale.length === 2;

  
  (function applyLocalizationReturnTo() {
    var returnTo = sessionStorage.getItem('localization_return_to');
    if (!returnTo) return;
    sessionStorage.removeItem('localization_return_to');
    var currentPathAndQuery = parsedURL.pathname + parsedURL.search;
    if (currentPathAndQuery === returnTo) return;
    window.location.replace(returnTo.startsWith('/') ? returnTo : '/' + returnTo);
  })();

  function redirectToPreferredLocale(newLocale) {
    if (isValidLocale) {
      if (existingLocale.toUpperCase() === newLocale.toUpperCase()) {
        // If the URL already contains the passed locale, return the original URL
        return;
      }
      if (newLocale === 'en') {
        // If the new locale is "en", remove the existing locale from the URL
        parts.splice(1, 1);
      } else {
        // If the new locale is not "en", replace the existing locale with the new locale
        parts[1] = newLocale;
      }
    } else {
      // If there is no existing locale or its length is not 2, append the new locale at the second position
      if (newLocale === 'en') {
        return;
      }
      parts.splice(1, 0, newLocale);
    }
    parsedURL.pathname = parts.join('/');
    window.location.replace(parsedURL.href);
  }
</script>

  <script>
    //check to see if redirection to browserlocale is needed
    const shouldRedirectUser = (browserLocale) => {
      //if user has changed lang from ddn or clicked a link from page in new tab do not redirect
       if(document.referrer.includes("myfonts.com")) return false;

      //if locale exits do not redirect user
      if(isValidLocale) {
          return false;
      }
      else {
        //checking to make sure the language is published on Shopify to avoid wrong redirects to 404
        const enabledLocales = [{"shop_locale":{"locale":"en","enabled":true,"primary":true,"published":true}},{"shop_locale":{"locale":"de","enabled":true,"primary":false,"published":true}},{"shop_locale":{"locale":"fr","enabled":true,"primary":false,"published":true}},{"shop_locale":{"locale":"es","enabled":true,"primary":false,"published":true}},{"shop_locale":{"locale":"pt-BR","enabled":true,"primary":false,"published":true}}];
        return enabledLocales.some((localeData) => localeData.shop_locale.published && (localeData.shop_locale.locale.split('-')[0] === browserLocale));
      }
    }

    const customAutoRedirectionToBrowserLocale = () => {
      const browserLocale = navigator.language.split('-')[0] || '';
      if(shouldRedirectUser(browserLocale)) {
        redirectToPreferredLocale(browserLocale);
      } else {
        return;
      }
    }

    // trigger browser auto redirect from client side
    customAutoRedirectionToBrowserLocale();
  </script>

          currencyCountry = 'NZ';
          break;
      }

      currencyLocale = `${currencyLocale}-${currencyCountry}`;

      // Format the number as currency without displaying the currency symbol/code
      const formatter = new Intl.NumberFormat(currencyLocale, {
        style: 'currency',
        currency: currency,
        // Use 'narrowSymbol' to minimize the impact of the symbol on the formatted string
        currencyDisplay: 'narrowSymbol'
      });

      // Format the amount
      let formattedAmount = formatter.format(amount);

      const symbol = formattedAmount.replace(/[\d.,]/g, '');

      // Remove the currency symbol and any extra spaces
      formattedAmount = formattedAmount.replace(/[^\d.,]/g, '');

      // Append the currency code at the end

  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    const header = document.querySelector('.gh-header');
    const headerTopContent = document.querySelector('.gh-header__top-content');
    
    if (!header || !headerTopContent || window.innerWidth < 1025) return;
    
    const observer = new MutationObserver(function(mutations) {
      mutations.forEach(function(mutation) {
        if (mutation.attributeName === 'class' || mutation.attributeName === 'style') {
          if (headerTopContent.style.height === '0px' || headerTopContent.style.height === '0') {
            headerTopContent.style.height = '';
            headerTopContent.style.overflow = '';
          }
        }
      });
    });
    
    observer.observe(header, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] });
    
    observer.observe(headerTopContent, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['style'] });
  });

<script>
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    const header = document.querySelector('.gh-header');
    const headerTopContent = document.querySelector('.gh-header__top-content');
    const logoSvg = document.querySelector('.gh-header__logo svg');

    if (!header || !headerTopContent || window.innerWidth < 1025) return;

    // Ensure logo is always 70% width
    if (logoSvg) {
      logoSvg.style.width = '70%';
    }

    const observer = new MutationObserver(function(mutations) {
      mutations.forEach(function(mutation) {
        if (mutation.attributeName === 'class' || mutation.attributeName === 'style') {
          if (headerTopContent.style.height === '0px' || headerTopContent.style.height === '0') {
            headerTopContent.style.height = '';
            headerTopContent.style.overflow = '';
          }
          // Always maintain 70% width on logo
          if (logoSvg) {
            logoSvg.style.width = '70%';
          }
        }
      });
    });

    observer.observe(header, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] });

    observer.observe(headerTopContent, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['style'] });

    // Also observe the logo directly in case it gets modified
    if (logoSvg) {
      const logoObserver = new MutationObserver(function(mutations) {
        mutations.forEach(function(mutation) {
          if (mutation.attributeName === 'style') {
            logoSvg.style.width = '70%';
          }
        });
      });
      logoObserver.observe(logoSvg, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['style'] });
    }
  });
</script>

<script>
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    const dropdowns = document.querySelectorAll('.gh-dropdown, .gh-menu');
  
    dropdowns.forEach((dropdown) => {
      const trigger = dropdown.querySelector('.gh-current-selection') || dropdown.querySelector('.gh-fs-13');
      const options = dropdown.querySelector('.gh-options') || dropdown.querySelector('.gh-submenu');
  
      if (trigger && options) {
        trigger.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
          if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
            e.preventDefault();
            toggleDropdown(dropdown);
          } 
        });

        dropdown.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
          if (e.key === 'Escape') {
            closeDropdown(dropdown);
            if (trigger) trigger.focus();
          }
        });
      }
      dropdown.addEventListener('focusout', (e) => {
        setTimeout(() => {
          if (!dropdown.contains(document.activeElement)) {
            closeDropdown(dropdown);
          }
        }, 0);
      });
  
      if (dropdown && dropdown.classList?.contains('gh-menu')) {
        const submenuLinks = dropdown.querySelectorAll('.gh-submenu__tabs__text');
        submenuLinks.forEach((link) => {
          link.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
              e.preventDefault();
              if (link.href) {
                window.location.href = link.href;
              }
            }
          });
        });
      }
  
      if (options && dropdown.classList.contains('gh-dropdown')) {
        options.querySelectorAll('li').forEach((option) => {
          option.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {  
              if (option.classList.contains('gh-nested-dropdown')) {
                e.preventDefault();
                const nestedOptions = option.querySelector('.gh-nested-options');
                if (nestedOptions) {
                  nestedOptions.style.display = 'block';
                }
              } else {
                const link = option.querySelector('a');
                const button = option.querySelector("button");

                if (link) {
                  link.click();
                } else if (button) {
                  button.click(); 
                } else {
                  option.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent("click", { bubbles: true })); 
                }
              }
            }
          });
        });
      }
    });
  
    function toggleDropdown(dropdown) {
      const isMenu = dropdown.classList.contains('gh-menu');
      const submenu = isMenu ? dropdown.querySelector('.gh-submenu') : dropdown.querySelector('.gh-options');
  
      if (submenu) {
        const isVisible = submenu.classList.contains('open');
        if (!isVisible) {
          dropdown.classList.add('open');
          submenu.style.display = 'block'; 
          showOverlay(); 
        } else {
          dropdown.classList.remove('open');
          submenu.style.display = 'none'; 
          hideOverlay(); 
        }
      }
    }
  
    function closeDropdown(dropdown) {
      dropdown.classList.remove('open');
      const submenu = dropdown.querySelector('.gh-submenu') || dropdown.querySelector('.gh-options');
      if (submenu) {
        submenu.style.display = 'none';
      }
      hideOverlay();
    }
  
    function showOverlay() {
      document.body.classList.add('gh-overlay-active'); 
    }
  
    function hideOverlay() {
      document.body.classList.remove('gh-overlay-active'); 
    }

    const subscriptionPlansElement = document.querySelector('.gh-marketo-cta-title > a');

    if (subscriptionPlansElement) {
      subscriptionPlansElement.addEventListener("keydown", function (event) {
        if (event.key === 'Tab' && !event.shiftKey) {
          const privyButtons = document.querySelectorAll(`
            #privy-widget div[role="button"][tabindex="0"],
            #privy-container div[role="button"][tabindex="0"]
          `);

          const privyButton = privyButtons.length > 0 ? privyButtons[0] : null;

          if (privyButton) {
            event.preventDefault();
            privyButton.focus();

            const focusableElements = Array.from(
              document.querySelectorAll(`
                #MainContent a,
                #MainContent button,
                #MainContent input,
                #MainContent select,
                #MainContent textarea,
                #MainContent [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])
              `)
            ).filter(
              (el) =>
                !el.disabled &&
                el.offsetParent !== null &&
                el.getAttribute("tabindex") != "-1"
            );

            const firstElement = focusableElements.length > 0 ? focusableElements[0] : null;
            const privyButtonListenerAttached = window._privyButtonListenerAttached === true;

            if (!privyButtonListenerAttached) {
              window._privyButtonListenerAttached = true;
              privyButton.addEventListener("keydown", function (event) {
                if (event.key === 'Tab') {
                  event.preventDefault();
    
                  if (event.shiftKey) {
                     subscriptionPlansElement.focus();
                  } else {
                    if (firstElement) {
                      firstElement.focus();
                    } else {
                      document.querySelector("#MainContent").focus();
                    }
                  }
                }
              });
              privyButton.addEventListener("focusin", function (event) {
                const privyCloseButton = document.querySelector('button.privy-dismiss-content');

                if (
                  ![firstElement, subscriptionPlansElement, privyCloseButton].includes(
                    event.relatedTarget
                  )
                ) {
                  privyButton.blur();
                }
              });
            }

            if (firstElement) {
              const firstElementListenerAttached = window._firstElementListenerAttached === true;

              if (!firstElementListenerAttached) {
                window._firstElementListenerAttached = true;
                firstElement.addEventListener("keydown", function (event) {
                  if (event.key === 'Tab' && event.shiftKey) {
                    event.preventDefault();
                    privyButton.focus()
                  }
                });
              }
            }
          }
        }
      });
    }
  });
</script></div>

      function getSessionStorageCollection() {
        let itemsInSessionStorage = sessionStorage.getItem("onLoginAddToFav");
        if (!itemsInSessionStorage) {
          itemsInSessionStorage = [];
        } else {
          itemsInSessionStorage = itemsInSessionStorage.split(",");
        }
        return itemsInSessionStorage;
      }
    
      function setSessionStorageCollection(handle) {
        const itemsInSessionStorage = getSessionStorageCollection();
        if (!itemsInSessionStorage.includes(handle)) {
          itemsInSessionStorage.push(handle);
        }
        sessionStorage.setItem("onLoginAddToFav", itemsInSessionStorage.join(","));
        window.setTrue = true;
      }
    
      function removeSessionStorageCollection(handle) {
        const itemsInSessionStorage = getSessionStorageCollection();
        const index = itemsInSessionStorage.indexOf(handle);
        if (index > -1) {
          itemsInSessionStorage.splice(index, 1);
        }
        if (itemsInSessionStorage.length === 0) {
          sessionStorage.removeItem("onLoginAddToFav");
        } else {
          sessionStorage.setItem("onLoginAddToFav", itemsInSessionStorage.join(","));
        }
      }
    
      // Add session favorites after login

          // check if item is already a favorite
          if (item && item.classList.contains("favorites-icon-inactive")) {

        });

      $(".albumfilterbtn").keydown(function (event) {
        if (event.code === 'Tab') {
          const expanded = $(event.target).parent(".albumfilterbtn").attr("aria-expanded") === "true";

      function bindAlbumDropdownFocusout() {
        $(`
          .album_sidebar_controls .album_list_left > a,
          .album_sidebar_controls .album_check_right > input[type="checkbox"],
          .album_sidebar_controls .album_button_left,
          .album_sidebar_controls .album_button_right,
          .album_sidebar_controls .album_list_left_input > input[name="newalbum"],
          .album_sidebar_controls .album_remove_right > .remove-album 
        `).unbind("blur").unbind("keydown").on("keydown blur", function (event) {
          let checkForReverseTab = false;

          const is_new_album_visible = $(".album_list_first").is(":visible");

          if (is_new_album_visible) {
            const new_album_input = $("input[name='newalbum']");

            if (new_album_input.length > 0) {
              checkForReverseTab = event.target == new_album_input[0];
            }
          } else {
            const album_anchor_list = $(".album_sidebar_controls li .album_list_left a");

            if (album_anchor_list.length > 0) {
              checkForReverseTab = event.target == album_anchor_list[0]
            }
          }

          if (event.code == 'Tab' && event.shiftKey && checkForReverseTab) {
            const hidden_product_id = document.querySelector("input#current_product_id").value;

            if (hidden_product_id) {
                albumDropdownButton = $(`.owl-item.active .carousel-item[data-product-id="${hidden_product_id}"]:eq(0) .albumfilterbtn[aria-expanded="true"] > a`);
                albumDropdownButton.focus();
                return false;
            }
          } else if (event.type == "blur" || event.code == 'Escape') {
            const withinAlbumDropdown = $(event.relatedTarget).closest(".album_sidebar_controls").length > 0;
  
            if (!withinAlbumDropdown) {
              const hidden_product_id = document.querySelector("input#current_product_id").value;
  
              if (hidden_product_id) {
                albumDropdownButton = $(`.owl-item.active .carousel-item[data-product-id="${hidden_product_id}"]:eq(0) .albumfilterbtn[aria-expanded="true"] > a`);
  
                if (albumDropdownButton[0] !== event.relatedTarget) {
                  $(".album_sidebar_controls").css("display", "none");
                  $(albumDropdownButton).parents(".albumfilterbtn").attr("aria-expanded", "false");
                  $(albumDropdownButton).find('.arrow-down')[0].style.transform = "rotateY(180deg)";

                  const currentSlideItems = $('.owl-item.active');
                  const currentItem = $(albumDropdownButton).closest('.item-wrapper').parent('.owl-item');
                  const isLastItemInSlide = currentItem.is(currentSlideItems.last());
          
                  // get all focusable elements in current item
                  const focusableElements = currentItem.find('a, button, input, select, textarea, [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])').filter(':visible');
                  const lastFocusableElement = focusableElements.last()[0];

                  //dont transition to next slide if we're at the last item in the last slide
                  const isLastSlide = $('.owl-item:not(.cloned)').last().hasClass('active');

                  $(albumDropdownButton).focus();

                  if (isLastItemInSlide && document.activeElement === lastFocusableElement && !isLastSlide) {
                    owl.trigger('next.owl.carousel', [300]);
                  } else {
                    if (event.relatedTarget !== $('#MainContent')[0]) {
                      jumpAlbumDropdownNextFocus(albumDropdownButton[0]);
                    }
                  }

                  playPauseOwlCarousel(true);
                }
              }
            }
          }
        });
      }

      function jumpAlbumDropdownNextFocus(currentElement) {
        // Select all focusable elements that are visible
        const focusableSelectors = 'a, button, input, select, textarea, [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])';
        const nodeList = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(focusableSelectors));

        // Filter out elements that are not visible or are disabled
        const focusable = nodeList.filter(el => {
          return !el.disabled && el.tabIndex !== -1 && el.offsetParent !== null && window.getComputedStyle(el).visibility !== 'hidden';
        });

        // Find the index of the current element
        const idx = focusable.indexOf(currentElement);
        // Focus the next element, if it exists
        if (idx > -1 && idx < focusable.length - 1) {
          focusable[idx + 1].focus();
        }
      }

      function enableSubmitButton() {

        const element = document.querySelector('#buttonsubmitfirstname');

        if (firstNameInput != '' && secondNameInput != '') {
          element.classList.remove('disabled');
          element.classList.add('disabledtrue');
        } else {
          element.classList.remove('disabledtrue');
          element.classList.add('disabled');
        }
      }

      function getCookie(cname) {
        let name = cname + '=';
        let ca = document.cookie.split(';');
        for (let i = 0; i < ca.length; i++) {
          let c = ca[i];
          while (c.charAt(0) == ' ') {
            c = c.substring(1);
          }
          if (c.indexOf(name) == 0) {
            return c.substring(name.length, c.length);
          }
        }
        return '';
      }
    </script>

# Agent Instructions — MyFonts

You can browse products and shop at MyFonts's online store, https://www.myfonts.com, on your user's behalf. This guide covers the Shop skill and UCP integration, directly or through browser-based WebMCP tools.

## Shop skill — recommended

Use the [Shop skill](https://shop.com/SKILL.md) to help your user shop with this store. Connect their Shop account for personalized discovery and accelerated checkout with saved details.

- Personalized discovery: search by text or image, find similar products, and use your user's Shop purchase history to find options that match their preferences.
- Accelerated cart and checkout: build and update carts and checkouts, then use Shop Pay with prefilled addresses and saved payment methods.
- Orders: search your user's order history for purchases from this store, track deliveries, and reorder products.

Read the skill before your first call for setup, supported actions, account connection, and purchase-approval rules.

## UCP integration

This store implements the [Universal Commerce Protocol](https://ucp.dev) for product discovery, carts, and checkout. Integrate directly with its service, or orchestrate shopping through browser-based WebMCP tools.

### Direct integration (MCP)

1. **Discover the store** — `GET https://www.myfonts.com/.well-known/ucp` returns its UCP profile, including capabilities, service endpoints, and payment handlers.
2. **Discover available tools** — Connect to the MCP endpoint advertised in the profile (`https://www.myfonts.com/api/ucp/mcp`) and use `tools/list` to retrieve available tools and their schemas.
3. **Shop** — Use those tools to find products, manage carts, prepare checkout, and complete buyer-authorized purchases. Follow returned statuses, messages, and handoff URLs when buyer action is required.

Use a compatible UCP version and follow the returned tool schemas. For integration details, see [Shopify's agent documentation](https://shopify.dev/docs/agents).

### Browser integration (WebMCP)

When working through a browser, use the WebMCP tools registered on this store's pages. The checkout page exposes UCP tools over WebMCP. These tools act on the checkout in the current browser session.

- **Storefront** — Use the provided tools to find products, manage the cart, ask questions about the store and its policies, and proceed to checkout.
- **Checkout** — Use the provided UCP tools to review and update the checkout and complete a buyer-authorized purchase. Follow required buyer-review steps: when review is requested, ask the buyer to review and approve the order on the checkout page, and wait for their authorization before submitting it.

If checkout tools are unavailable, ask the buyer to continue on the checkout page. Do not fall back to scripted form fills or page controls.

For integration details, see [Storefront WebMCP](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/web-mcp) and [Checkout WebMCP](https://shopify.dev/docs/agents/carts-and-checkout/checkout-webmcp).

## Interaction guidelines

- **Buyer authorization** — Place orders and submit payment only with the buyer's authorization. Follow required review and approval steps.
- **Agent traffic** — Agents must identify their requests as agent-initiated. Server-to-server requests and hosted or remote browsers must use [Web Bot Auth](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/storefront#identifying-bots-with-web-bot-auth) and follow the service's authentication requirements. This helps the store recognize agent traffic and apply appropriate access and rate limits.
- **Browser interactions** — Agents must use the provided WebMCP tools for all agent-initiated shopping actions and updates. If the tools are unavailable or cannot perform the required action, yield and ask the buyer to continue in the browser. Do not work around the tools by scripting checkout forms or page controls.
- **Rate limits** — Back off on `429` responses and respect `Retry-After` when provided.
- **Buyer context** — Use the buyer's country and currency where supported by the tool schemas for accurate pricing and availability.

## Read-only browsing

Prefer the structured information returned by the shopping tools described above. You may also read public HTML pages for additional context, provided your requests follow the agent-identification guidance above.

- Discover public URLs through `/sitemap.xml`.
- Read product pages at `/products/{handle}`.
- Browse collections at `/collections/all` or `/collections/{handle}`.
- Discover other public pages and articles through the sitemap.

Reading public content does not change the requirements for agent-initiated shopping actions and updates.


## Store Policies
- **Privacy policy**: https://www.myfonts.com/policies/privacy-policy
- **Terms of service**: https://www.myfonts.com/policies/terms-of-service
- **Refund policy**: https://www.myfonts.com/policies/refund-policy


## Platform

This store is built on [Shopify](https://www.shopify.com), the commerce platform powering millions of stores worldwide. Shopify stores support UCP natively, enabling seamless agent-driven commerce. The Shop skill at
[https://shop.app/SKILL.md](https://shop.app/SKILL.md) works across every Shopify store — install it once and
your agent can transact everywhere.

- Start your own store: https://www.shopify.com/start
- Build and test against sample data: https://mock.shop (free mock Storefront GraphQL API, no store or auth needed)
- Shopify developer platform: https://shopify.dev
- Shop developer platform: https://shop.dev

- Agent discovery: this document (`/agents.md`) is the canonical agent-facing description of the store.
